metricSemantics.confirmEventsAndAppend: One non-empty ConfirmEventsAsync call maps to one IEventStore.AppendAsync call on this path.
metricSemantics.serializedBytes: Serialized bytes are low-allocation StateEvent.CalculateSize scalar totals from adapter-returned committed records; the append decorator does not clone them.
metricSemantics.mailboxOccupancy: Mailbox occupancy is in-flight plus queued chat turns. The harness awaits one dispatch at a time, so max occupancy is one; chunks remain inside that actor turn.
metricSemantics.percentiles: Nearest-rank percentiles: ceil(p * sample_count) - 1 after ascending sort.
metricSemantics.resourceDeltas: Net CPU/allocation values come from an alternating-order matched control turn with append/snapshot measurement decorators removed. Gross values include those decorators; their signed difference estimates instrumentation cost. Both remain process-level and noisy.
metricSemantics.crashRecovery: Crash recovery compares append-acknowledged progress with real CommittedStateEventPublished observations by event identity, session sequence, and payload fingerprint. Each fence reports only its observed window.

identity.imageReferenceEvidence: Repository implementation selected directly by the harness.
Operator-declared pinned digest; server name/version independently verified through INFO and HELLO.
